contents.reason: The originally read source sampling proof is comparison context. contents.name: Chapter 4 Theorem 4.2.1: local polynomial reproduction on compact cubes
contents.reason: The source exponential reproduction statement is retained as context and its citation to Madych-Nelson is honestly noted.
